description: ITMO University and SPC RAS publish DriverSVT, smartphone-measured vehicle and driver-state telemetry from 633 drivers. The deposit describes more than 17.56 million samples, combining phone inertial sensors with video-derived driver-state features and smartwatch heart rate. It lists a CSV dataset and Markdown documentation under CC BY 4.0, with free Zenodo access. The collection can calibrate driver-state observation models or test safety-related components of road simulations. The landing metadata does not specify the observation region, collection dates or uniform sampling frequency, so global applicability is an intended reuse scope, not demonstrated representativeness. Derived state labels depend on the original recognition algorithms. Only public metadata was inspected; individual-level rows were not read. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
